followup_adjudication.revised_judgment: No new_000015 top-strip annotation is supported. New_000029 shows a broad white rack-top backer/retainer behind two metal fastening posts, extending across the rack. New_000017 shows the same arrangement. Structural surface is the better-supported interpretation.
